description: Get All Stocks. Part of the Stocks APIs in Giddh. Requires Auth-Key or Session-Id.

q.description: Search text (case sensitivity depends on the endpoint).

count.description: Page size (number of items returned). Default: 0.

refresh.description: When true, bypass cache and recompute. Default: true.

isManufactured.description: Is manufactured query parameter. Default: false.
